profiles.review: Read-only analysis, verification, and council debate.
profiles.media: Image or video generation with artifact verification. Provider capabilities are declared per provider in media_capabilities.

hosts.claude: Claude Code session acting as orchestrator.
hosts.codex: Codex session acting as orchestrator; sandboxed.
hosts.grok: Grok CLI session acting as orchestrator; sandboxed.
hosts.shell: Plain shell, used for diagnostics and acceptance tests.

routes.direct: Plain-shell diagnostics only; normal AI hosts use the typed loopback broker.
routes.broker: Common cross-provider route for all four AI hosts. An unavailable/stale broker fails closed; no automatic direct execution.
routes.requires_host_escalation: No automatic escalation. The user must re-run the same command outside the host sandbox with --host-escalated.
routes.in_process: Self-delegation. The host answers in-process instead of spawning another copy of itself.
routes.companion_preferred: A host-native companion or plugin is the primary path; the CLI adapter is the fallback.

claude.notes: Auto mode with a profile-specific system guard. Persistent sessions use an explicit UUID. No model is pinned by default; the envelope reports account_default_unpinned rather than inventing a name.

reasoning_efforts.notes: Adapter allowlist; actual support depends on the selected model. Omit effort to retain native CLI defaults.

media_capabilities.tool: codex built-in image_gen via the imagegen system skill
media_capabilities.notes: Verified 2026-07-25: image_gen works under --sandbox read-only and writes to ~/.codex/generated_images/<thread-id>/. Requires mode fresh because the thread id is how the artifact directory is located. Codex has no video generation.

codex.notes: Read-only or workspace-write sandbox selected by profile. Fresh session IDs are parsed from JSONL.

media_capabilities.tool: Grok Build Imagine (image_gen, image_to_video) on the logged-in consumer subscription
media_capabilities.notes: Never uses xAI API credentials. Video output on a ZDR team requires a private upload target; the adapter refuses with zdr_output_required instead of retrying.

grok.notes: Review/research/media use native read-only. Work requires a separately installed crosscrew-target-v1 custom profile extending strict; no runtime directories are implicitly granted. Known expiring native login may be refreshed with grok models before work. No credentials are exported.

os_sandbox.reason: A 2026-07-25 live probe showed agy's --mode plan --sandbox does not stop its file-writing tools: it created, overwrote, and wrote outside the target. Write confinement is enforced by seatbelt instead of being assumed.

agy.notes: Native JSON answer/conversation ID/usage parsing. Fresh/resume reuse the observed conversation ID. Work commands require explicit exact grants and outer OS write confinement. Web tool availability and permissions vary.
